STATIC: P12/Static_trial.csv is the real static (unmapped in manual_frames.csv; still to
0.06 mm/frame), but Vicon's labels on it are wrong almost everywhere (fit errors to 217 mm).
It is used RELABELLED by the SOMA model: results/soma/labels/P12/static/soma_labelled.csv
MOVEMENT: P12's movement trials are named Static_trial01-04 (manual_frames.csv: Trial 1 Hands
only = 01, Trial 1 HOI = 02, Trial2 Hands only = 03, Trial2 HOI = 04). Fit them relabelled by
REUSED FROM P10, NOT MEASURED ON P12:
- attach_file: P10's hand-picked vertices. They encode the marker protocol (MCP, PIP, base
of nailbed) on MANO's shared topology, so they transfer as a starting point; the static
stage then searches the remaining markers. On P12's static the surface fit converges to
- stretch_file: P10's flexion-dependent skin slide. Skin mechanics, plausibly similar, but
P12's hand is larger (proximal segments 8-14 mm longer), so the slopes are approximate.
